01 / Agents

Agents I have built for Finacle.

Each agent handles a clear task. Click a card to see what it does.

01
Finacle agent

Requirements Analyst

Reads product requirements and turns them into a clear, detailed flow document.

+

It finds missing details before design starts. If a branch, field, error case, or end state is unclear, it asks the product team instead of making up an answer.

  • Lists every field and how it behaves.
  • Maps decisions, branches, and edge cases.
  • Records assumptions and open questions.
CREATES / A clear requirements document with fields, decisions, edge cases, and open questions
02
Finacle agent

UX Flow Designer

Turns the requirements document into a clear plan for a UX flow diagram.

+

It decides how screens, fields, decisions, and branches should appear in the flow. The journey starts at Customer 360 and moves from left to right.

  • Groups fields that belong on the same screen.
  • Avoids repeating shared fields on every branch.
  • Asks questions when the flow is unclear.
CREATES / A plan showing every screen, field, branch, and connection needed in the diagram
03
Finacle agent

FigJam Renderer

Takes the flow plan and draws it as an editable FigJam diagram.

+

It uses Figma tools to create the nodes and connections in the Finacle purple style. The final flow stays editable, so a designer can review and change it.

  • Draws the main journey and smaller sub-flows.
  • Checks that every field is included.
  • Returns an editable FigJam link.
CREATES / An editable FigJam flow that the design team can review and update
04
Finacle agent

Layer Renamer

Renames layers in a Figma screen using Finacle’s Scrabble Guidelines v4.0.

+

It first looks at the design to understand each element. It then matches visible fields to their layers and gives each layer the correct name.

  • Changes names only, not the design.
  • Checks every name after applying it.
  • Flags layers it cannot identify.
CREATES / Correct Figma layer names and a simple report of what changed
02 / Skills

Skills and guidelines I have built for Finacle.

These files teach the agents how Finacle designs should be named and how Finacle flow diagrams should look.

Reusable skill

Finacle Layer Naming

A reusable skill for naming Figma layers. It covers text, buttons, pages, lists, overlays, expanders, and pre-filled inputs.

Dynamic value Dynamic-Component-MeaningValue

Naming Guidelines

The full Scrabble v4.0 rules used by the Layer Renamer. It explains how names should be written and checked.

Flow Style Guide

Defines the purple visual style, field groups, connections, branches, and left-to-right layout used in Finacle flows.
